title: September 21, 2026
body:
This serverless compute release includes updates from [Databricks Runtime 19](/aws/en/release-notes/runtime/19).

#### New features

* **`truncate` function**: The `truncate` function truncates a number to a specified scale without rounding.
* **`trim_array` function**: The `trim_array` function removes the specified number of elements from the end of an array.
